household.title: Welcome!
household.intro: Let’s set up your calendar: your household, your kids, then your custody schedule.
household.usHolidays: You’ll add your school district’s holidays in Settings (there’s no national school calendar in the US).

children.title: Your kids
children.intro: A first name is enough. No last name or school: we keep only what we need.

notifications.title: Never miss a handover
notifications.intro: Turn on notifications: Alternly reminds you at the right time, without you having to open the app.
notifications.itemHandover: A reminder the day before each handover
notifications.itemSwap: Swap requests from the other parent to review
notifications.itemActivity: New expenses or messages on the board
notifications.footer: You can then choose what you receive in Settings › Notifications.

paywall.title: Your calendar is ready
paywall.intro: Go further with Premium: shared expenses and a board between parents. One subscription covers you both.

patterns.alternateWeeksDesc: One week with each parent, with a fixed handover day.
patterns.everyOtherWeekendDesc: Your child lives with one parent; the other has them every other weekend.
patterns.twoTwoThreeDesc: 2 days each, then 3 days. Often chosen for little ones.
patterns.customDesc: You place the days yourself over two weeks.

wizard.patternIntro: Pick the closest match to your arrangement. You’ll fine-tune it day by day right after.
wizard.weekendRest_one: The rest of the time, {{kids}} lives with the other parent. Weekends then alternate on their own.
wizard.weekendRest_other: The rest of the time, {{kids}} live with the other parent. Weekends then alternate on their own.
wizard.checkIntro: A day doesn’t fit? Tap it to give it to the other parent. The cycle then repeats every two weeks.
wizard.splitHalfDesc: Each break is split in two. The order flips every year.
wizard.alternateFullDesc: The whole break with one parent, then with the other the following year.
wizard.firstHalfQuestion: This year ({{year}}), who has the first half?
wizard.fullQuestion: This year ({{year}}), who has the holidays?
wizard.exampleSplitMe: Example: for the next holidays, you have the first half and the other parent the second. Next year, it’s the other way around.
wizard.exampleSplitOther: Example: for the next holidays, the other parent has the first half and you the second. Next year, it’s the other way around.
wizard.exampleFullMe: Example: this year, the holidays are with you; next year, with the other parent.
wizard.exampleFullOther: Example: this year, the holidays are with the other parent; next year, with you.

rules.saved: Rules saved: the calendar is up to date.
rules.title: Custody and holidays
